name: @rnr/supply-feed
description: Publish a directory site's supply (listings, inventory) as a read-only, cursor-paginated HTTP feed.
//private: The ONLY non-private package in this workspace. @rnr/core and @rnr/data are private:true and export raw TypeScript, consumed exclusively under `tsx --conditions=react-server`. This one is installed into a SEPARATE codebase (hotelhottubs.com) that has no such loader, so it must be a real built artifact with real type declarations.
//deps: ZERO runtime dependencies, and unlike @rnr/core this is not a stylistic preference. This package is installed into someone else's dependency tree; anything it pulls in is a version conflict waiting to happen in a codebase we do not control. Everything it needs (fetch, URL, crypto.timingSafeEqual) is in Node >= 18.

scripts.//build: tsc, not tsup or rollup. A bundler would be one more dependency in this repo for a package whose whole point is having none, and tsc already emits both module formats plus declarations. The two `package.json` marker files are what tell Node which format each dist directory is, since the root manifest says `type: module`.
scripts.//prepare: dist/ is gitignored repo-wide, so a `git+https://...` install would land with no build output at all. npm and pnpm run `prepare` after installing from a git URL, which is the hook that fixes it — and it is why typescript below is a devDependency of THIS package rather than only of the repo root: on that path the root's node_modules does not exist. devDependencies are not installed transitively, so this adds nothing to the consuming site's tree.
